messages.subject_clean: R-GSOC 2024 application: Need support from memtors to list projects
messages.body_plain:
Dear GSOC Mentors,

Google OSPO is reviewing applications for 2024. We have only a few projects lists on the projects page <https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2024/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects> right now. I would like to request all the mentors to please list potential projects soon, to make our application stronger.

Thanks and regards,

Vijay

--
---
Vijay Barve
GSoC :R Project Org Admin
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/
---
